title: Problems in spectral analysis of canonical Hamiltonian systems
summary: This note focuses on recent results in spectral analysis of canonical systems of differential equations obtained via the approach developed in our previous papers \cite{MIF1, MP3, etudes, etudes2, PZ, Direct}. Many of our results are motivated by the pioneering research of Barry Simon and his co-authors; see, for instance, the papers cited in the main text. We discuss solutions to the inverse spectral problem (ISP) for canonical Hamiltonian systems and mixed spectral problems for Schrödinger operators.
